name: a_hospital_corridor_with_wet_floor_zones
description: A bright hospital corridor with freshly mopped wet-floor zones under yellow caution signs, frosted-glass sliding doors opened by floor pads, supply carts to steer around, and rounds through the ward, the X-ray bay and the operating theatre.
theme: a hospital corridor with wet-floor zones, sliding doors and supply carts

zones.name: ward_a
zones.label: the blue rug by the hospital bed

zones.name: supply_room
zones.label: the yellow mat in the supply room

zones.name: operating_theatre
zones.label: the white mat by the operating table

zones.name: xray_bay
zones.label: the purple ring on the X-ray platform

zones.name: delivery_spot
zones.label: the green circle at the nurse's station

tasks.name: wet_round_to_reception
tasks.instruction: Walk the length of the corridor to the red rug under the big red cross at reception. The shiny blue patches are freshly mopped and very slippery, and don't step in the green spill.
paraphrases: Head west down the corridor to the red rug at reception, careful on the wet floor.
Go to the red-cross end of the corridor and stop on the red rug, avoiding the green spill.

tasks.name: xray_appointment
tasks.instruction: Go through the open doorway across the corridor into the X-ray room, walk up the blue ramp onto the white platform and stand in the purple ring for your scan.
paraphrases: Cross the corridor to the X-ray room and step up onto the scanner platform.
Enter the X-ray room, climb the little blue ramp and wait in the purple ring.

tasks.name: restock_supply_room
tasks.instruction: Step on the blue floor pad by the glass sliding door to open the supply room, then go inside and stop on the yellow mat.
paraphrases: Press the blue pad to slide open the supply-room door, then walk in to the yellow mat.
Open the supply room with the blue floor pad and stop on the yellow mat inside.

tasks.name: scrub_in
tasks.instruction: Step on the green floor pad to open the operating theatre's sliding door, then go in and stand on the white mat by the operating table.
paraphrases: Press the green pad, wait for the glass door to rise, and go into the theatre.
Open the theatre door with the green floor pad and stop on the white mat inside.

tasks.name: deliver_supplies
tasks.instruction: Push the little white supply crate along the corridor into the green circle at the nurse's station desk.
paraphrases: Shove the white box down the corridor to the green ring by the desk.
Deliver the supply crate: push it into the green circle at the nurse's station.

tasks.name: nurse_rounds
tasks.instruction: Do your rounds: first the blue rug by the hospital bed in the ward, then up the ramp onto the X-ray platform, and finish on the red rug at reception.
paraphrases: Check the ward, then the X-ray bay, then reception, in that order.
Make your rounds: the bed's blue rug, the purple scanner ring, then the red rug at the front.
